title: Noises and vibrations
purpose: How a noise complaint is taken and inspected.
facts: Six questions with what each answer points to.
A ride with the technician is offered at drop-off.
Usual causes in order: sway bar links, struts or shocks, wheel bearing, control arm bushings.

rows.Ask: Over bumps, or on smooth road?
rows.Because: Bumps: links, bushings, struts. Smooth: bearings, tires
Turning: CV axle, wheel bearing, strut mount
Then it is a brake inspection
A hum that rises with speed is a bearing or a tire

rows.Ask: Front or back, left or right?

rows.Because: Bushings and belts complain in the cold
